interface.reset: No reset port exists in the original interface.

semantics.sampling: On each rising clk edge, synchronous load captures data when load is high; otherwise ena high selects a shift; otherwise hold q.
semantics.priority_evidence: Original (1): Loads shift register with data instead of shifting.
semantics.initialization: Original specifies no initialization. RTL has none; simulation state is unknown until loaded.
semantics.latency: q updates following the accepting edge with no additional pipeline stage.

numeric.left: Discard high bits and insert zeros at low bits.
numeric.right: Replicate old bit 63 into vacated high bits.
numeric.overflow: 64-bit bit-vector truncation; no saturation or rounding.

verification.oracle: Independent bit-by-bit shift model derived from the original direction/amount mapping.
verification.sampling: Drive at falling edge, check stability before rising edge, check q after rising-edge NBA updates.
cases: all modes with positive and negative boundary patterns

specification_ambiguities.issue: Clock edge is not explicitly named.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Use the conventional rising edge for this synchronous shift register; no falling-edge behavior is suggested.
